items.title: Emmett Johnson: Stellar showing in Week 10 win
items.text:
Johnson rushed 22 times for 101 yards and brought in six of seven targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rashee Rice: Productive with five catches in win
items.text:
Rice brought in five of six targets for 82 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Clears century mark in scrimmage yards
items.text:
Taylor rushed 16 times for 83 yards and brought in two of four targets for 20 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Indianapolis.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Nico Collins: Very busy in Week 10 loss
items.text:
Collins secured nine of 16 targets for 94 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Heads to locker room Sunday
items.text:
Bowers headed to the locker room during Sunday's game against the Seahawks due to an ankle issue, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Five-TD day in win
items.text:
Mahomes completed 22 of 35 passes for 348 yards with five touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for 15 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
